_comment: Voice-over for the submission video, one entry per beat of tests/demo.spec.ts. scripts/make-video.mjs speaks each line with Piper, the demo waits for each line to finish before the next beat, and the same text is burned in as captions. The 'say' line is also played into the browser's microphone, so the real Amazon Transcribe hears it.
title: SpatialDesk
subtitle: A focus companion for minds that wander: an AI that plans your day with you, works beside you, and lets you undo anything. On Meta Quest and Meta VR Glasses.

beats.text: If your mind wanders, starting is the hardest part. SpatialDesk is a focus companion you wear. First, I tell it my day, in my own words.
Inside, I sit at my desk at dusk, and that small light beside my board is my companion. Working next to someone makes it easier to start, and to keep going.
One tap on Plan my day. The companion shimmers while Amazon Nova thinks, and the same Kotlin engine that runs in the headset checks every step.
Nothing changes until I say so. Each step says what it will do, and why.
One tap applies it: a Today board, a focus timer, and the world around me fades, so only my work stays in view.
By hand it's just as direct. Pick a card up, drop it in Doing. Every target is tested against hand-tracking jitter.
Put the dentist call at the top of my list.
Amazon Transcribe hears me, and the agent turns my words into a plan I can check. One tap, or a yes, applies it.
My companion works with me. The time left glows round its middle, so I can see time pass. When the block ends, my plant grows a leaf.
And the agent notices on its own. The report is not finished, so it suggests a break, not a false done.
The AI log shows everything the agent did: each step with its reason, and its own undo, even after later changes.
Hands-free: I look at a button and hold my gaze until the ring fills. Where the headset tracks my eyes, my eyes alone are enough.
The panel keeps score of my own work, day by day.
In the evening the agent wraps up my day. It names what I finished, clears it away, and my companion goes to sleep. Tomorrow starts from its words.
In my real room, Fit room stands my board on my desk, with my plant and my companion beside it. During a focus block the room recedes, and my desk stays.
And it is ready for Meta VR Glasses. The app reads the field of view the headset reports and fits the layout into it. I look at a card and pinch.
SpatialDesk: a focus companion for minds that wander. An agent you can audit, with hands, eyes or voice, in VR and in your own room. Open the link: there is nothing to install.
